features.label: Belt extender
features.text: Expands the Rebound Hip waist belt from its standard 48 in. maximum to fit hip circumferences of 49 to 67 in. using the same pulley and alligator clip closure system

features.label: Or kit surgical protection
features.text: Includes ankle protectors, perineal pad, knee wrap, and foot protectors that shield skin from pressure during intraoperative traction and prevent external rotation during sleep after surgery

features.label: Rotation strap
features.text: Wraps around the thigh and secures to the brace frame to restrict internal and external hip rotation for patients whose post-op protocol requires rotational control beyond flexion, extension, and abduction settings

features.label: Universal compatibility
features.text: All three accessories fit every Ossur Rebound Hip V2 configuration including standard and adjustable abduction hinge models with no tools or modifications

features.label: Sold separately
features.text: Each accessory ships individually so patients purchase only what their recovery protocol requires

features.label: Perfect fit guarantee
features.text: Free virtual fitting and adjustment session with US-based brace specialists
